citations.detail: Full-scale BEV fire tests reported per-vehicle peak HRR roughly 4-6 MW; preset widens to 2-7 MW to cover smaller/older NMC packs and test-to-test spread.
citations.source: RISE full-scale BEV fire tests (public summary)

citations.detail: Surveys of EV traction-battery fire incidents report pack sizes 40-100 kWh for passenger cars and multi-MW peaks when the full pack becomes involved.

notes: Gia dinh mot phan: dai dinh HRR 2-7 MW/xe bao phu bien do thi nghiem; toc do lan truyen giua cac module va tac dong lam mat/chua chay chua duoc tham so hoa, can hieu chinh theo cau hinh xe cu the va tham dinh doc lap.
